entries.en: column, pillar.
entries.notes: L 栏“arigue”疑为当地语（他加禄 haligi，柱）之义注，四栏于“柱”义一致。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏词形残乱（“Cbico ch fanco”），H、M、R 三栏皆空，无从定夺。

entries.en: to set out wine; to prepare the feast.
entries.notes: H 栏有[疑]（設/沒），M 作 pierchiù 近“備酒”，义取置办酒食。

entries.en: to invite; to ask someone to do something.
entries.notes: L 栏“seahaçeralgo”为“se ha(ze)r algo”之缩写，M 栏另存 yó 一读。

entries.zh: 分；分发、分与（把东西分给众人）。
entries.en: to share out, to distribute.
entries.notes: M 栏声调标记 T99 污损；H“分”、M pun、R fǔn 三者一致，字义仍可定。

entries.en: to invite someone to stay; to lodge, to host.
entries.notes: H 栏作“晋”，与 M laū、R lên 不合，疑为“留”之讹（留 lâu＝留客），义依 L“hospedar”定。

entries.en: to invite (by entreaty); to ask someone to come.
to lead along, to bring a group (to something).
entries.notes: H“率”与 M chut、R chūn 音不协，且 M 栏 T99 污损，义据 L 栏“邀众人”推定。

entries.en: to invite courteously.
to summon, to call together (one's subjects).
entries.notes: L 栏“à [残] alos subditos”有残字，句义据上下文推为宣召臣民。

entries.en: to beckon, to call over; to invite one another.
guest; invited person.
entries.notes: M、R 两栏声调标记皆 T99 污损；L“Convidado”与 H“客”、que（客）互证，字义可定。

entries.en: guest; honored guest.

entries.zh: 酒席；备办酒席（排设酒馔）。
entries.en: banquet, feast; to set out the wine.
to invite people.
to invite to the feast; to call to drink.
entries.notes: H 栏“食請酒”三字与 M、R 两音（chià̃ chiù／chěng chīn）不齐，疑栏内多录，义依 L 栏“赴宴”定。

entries.en: to invite the passer-by (to join the table).
entries.notes: H 栏“食請盡”含[疑]（盡/進），与 M、R 两音不齐，义依 L 栏定。

entries.zh: 做主人；当东道（设席请客）。
entries.en: to play the host; to be the one who invites.
to invite along; to ask someone out (to go together).
to invite someone to lodge, who refuses.
entries.notes: H 栏“晋不帶”与 M laū mí xâ 对音不齐，首字与第 6 条同作“晋”，疑并为“留”之讹。

entries.zh: 谦让；把尊位让与地位不等之人（“讓天下”）。
entries.en: to yield, to defer (to those of unequal rank).
entries.notes: L 栏“desprincipes, desiguales”语义晦涩，义依 H“讓天下”定。

entries.zh: 让位；把席位让给尊长或外来贵客。
entries.en: to yield one's seat; to give place (to princes from outside).
entries.notes: L 栏“de fuere”疑为“de fuera”（外来），义依 H“讓位”定。

entries.zh: 谢酒；饮宴后向主人道谢。
entries.en: to give thanks for the wine; to return thanks after a feast.
banquet; a table spread with much food.
